title: bazel fails to build in Windows with 'indentation error' and syntax error at 'outdent': expected expression

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
I installed msys2 in c:\tools\msys64, updated it and I followed all the steps described on the page below:
http://bazel.io/docs/windows.html

here is the output of my build:

```
John@terrorvision MINGW64 /c/bazel
$ ./compile.sh
```
